title: The critical KPZ scale for the Averaging Process
summary: KPZ-type extremal fluctuations have recently been proved for several models of random walks in space-time random environments (RWRE) in $1+1$ dimensions. A general moment criterion predicts the spatial scale at which this behavior should occur, but does not by itself guarantee non-trivial fluctuations at that scale. In this paper, we show that the averaging process provides an instance in which this criterion is not sharp: because of a degeneracy in the update mechanism, the actual KPZ limit appears only beyond the predicted scale.
